features.name: Kotlin nullable toString builtin
features.scope: Validate kotlin.Any?.toString from pinned builtin metadata, resolve it through ordinary extension candidate selection and lower the selected builtin to the checked public String.valueOf(Object) JVM target. Nulls, boxed primitives, arrays, generic values, bound references, source/import/alias shadowing and ordinary Java member priority are exercised.

validation.null_override: An override returning Java null propagates it without an extra Java-expression assertion, matching the intrinsic contract and official bytecode. Exceptions and receiver evaluation counts are checked.
